title: When Do Task Vectors Interfere? Mapping the Validity Boundaries of Weight-Space Composition
abstract: arXiv:2608.09490v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Task arithmetic composes skills by adding weight displacements, and merged models are then judged on benchmark suites. We measure when that composition is functionally additive, and find that the answer depends as much on how the model is prompted as on which tasks are merged. Across two-dimensional composition surfaces -- five model settings from 0.5B to 8B, two families, LoRA and full fine-tuning -- pairwise non-additivity is real, seed-stable, and transfers in coarse order to unseen task pairs: all eight preregistered sign predictions held. But it is input-conditioned everywhere we measured: the same merged model that shows a six-point interaction contrast on code prompts shows none on math prompts, and wrapping the identical code prompts in the instruction template the adapters were trained on collapses the contrast twenty-fold, from +6.9 to +0.3 points -- while re-serializing them in an untrained chat template leaves it intact (

translated_title: 任务向量何时相互干扰？绘制权重空间组合的有效性边界
translated_abstract: 任务算术通过将权重位移相加来组合技能，随后合并后的模型会在基准测试套件上接受评估。我们测量了这种组合何时在功能上是可加的，并发现答案既取决于模型如何被提示，也取决于合并了哪些任务。在二维组合表面上——涵盖从0.5B到8B的五个模型设置、两个模型家族、LoRA与全量微调——两两非可加性是真实存在的、对随机种子稳定，并以粗略的顺序迁移到未见过的任务对上：所有八项预注册的符号预测均成立。但在我们测量的所有地方，这种效应都受输入条件制约：同一个合并模型在代码提示上显示出六分的交互对比，在数学提示上却显示不出；而将完全相同的代码提示包裹在适配器训练时所用的指令模板中，会使对比度坍缩约二十倍，从+6.9分降至+0.3分——然而，用未训练过的聊天模板重新序列化这些提示，对比度却保持不变（
tldr: 该研究发现合并模型中任务向量间的干扰效应虽然真实、稳定且可预测，但强烈依赖于输入提示的格式——用适配器训练时的指令模板包裹提示可使任务间交互对比坍缩约二十倍，表明权重空间组合的有效性边界主要由提示方式而非合并任务本身决定。
en_tdlr: Task-vector interference in merged models is real, seed-stable, and predictable, but strongly input-conditioned—wrapping prompts in the adapters' training instruction template collapses the interaction contrast twenty-fold—showing that the validity boundaries of weight-space composition depend as much on prompting as on which tasks are merged.
